entities.summary: Admiral James Oren Ellis Jr. is a retired 4-star admiral and former Commander, United States Strategic Command, Offutt Air Force Base, Nebraska. He was President and Chief Executive Officer, Institute of Nuclear Power Operations, until May 2012. He joined the board of directors of Lockheed Martin in 2004, and served until 2024.
